prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a low-speed head-on collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1272; do not mention it.)
text:
I am writing to advise that this office now represents the injured party in connection with the motor vehicle collision described above. Our client was hurt in a low-speed head-on collision and is currently receiving medical treatment for injuries that are still being evaluated. Please direct all future communications regarding this matter, including requests for statements, scheduling of examinations, and settlement discussions, exclusively to this firm. Our client should not be contacted directly by you or any person acting on your behalf.

We ask that you provide a certified copy of the policy declarations page, including all liability coverage limits that apply to the insured vehicle and driver, along with confirmation of any excess or umbrella coverage that may be available. Please also identify the claim handler assigned to this file.

We further request that your company preserve all evidence relating to the collision. This includes vehicle data and event recorder information, photographs, adjuster notes, recorded statements, repair or total-loss records, and any telematics or dashcam footage. Please suspend any routine deletion or disposal procedures that could affect this material until this matter is resolved.
